about: woman_stair dressed as people dress today (#225, owner 2026-11-25: the first outfit read as a 1950s costume): a fitted crew-neck heather grey jersey tee worn untucked over slim mid-rise mid-indigo jeans and knit running shoes (#228: the library's adopted knit runner, Shopify's Materials Variants Shoe, CC BY 4.0, fitted to her feet by tools/characters/accessories/shoe_model.py, in its charcoal street colourway). Each garment a GarmentCode design (assets/design_params at the pinned commit) with the settings named. The jeans: GarmentCode's Pants on a straight waistband, at its narrowest width (1.0), tapered to a slim 37 cm hem (flare 0.55, 32.6 cm of hem a unit of flare on her 65 cm thigh) and taken in at the knee to her knee's girth and 5 cm (knee_ease_cm, pattern.py `slim_legs`: GarmentCode cuts a leg straight from the thigh to the hem, and round 6's legs stood 56 cm round her 37 cm knee, read as baggy trousers and gathered at the calf as she walked); cut to end at her ankle bone (length 0.92: GarmentCode's leg length is her hips' level over the floor, 89.8 cm, so the hem is cut 0.08 of it, 7.2 cm, up, her ankle bone 0.039 of her height over her sole; worn at their cut level since #225 round 11, the 0.95 tuned while the band was held 10 cm too high would end 4.5 cm up); at a mid rise, the waistband's top 8.3 cm under her waist (rise 0.55 and a 4.2 cm band, waistband.width 0.15: the top sits at rise plus band of the way from her hip line to her waist; at rise 0.7 and a 5.5 cm band it sat 2.8 cm under her waist, too high, owner 2026-11-25); denim's own cloth row (data/physics/cloth.json `denim`). The tee: its t-shirt at its narrowest (shirt.width 1.0), to the hip (length 1.45), a close crew neck (collar.width -0.3, fc_depth 0.15: GarmentCode cuts the front's depth as that share of her neck-to-bust length, 22 cm, under the shoulder line's slope, 4.4 cm, so 0.15 drops it 7.7 cm, a women's crew neck's 7 to 8; at 0.3, GarmentCode's least, 11 cm read as a scoop, round 9), set-in sleeves angled down the arm (sleeve_angle 45, her arms at 48.5 degrees as sewn: at GarmentCode's 10, raised to her 21 degree shoulder slope, the sleeves stood out level as wings, round 6) and cut to a fitted tee's upper arm (connecting_width 0.3, 41 cm round: at 0.6, 51 cm, they stood off her arms; at 0.2 on a level sleeve the walking arms stretched them 9%, 2026-11-24). The tee drapes as the cloth recipe's woven cotton row: the table holds no knit row with a published source yet. Fabrics and construction marks are score's own score_lib surfaces (tools/characters/garments/fabrics.py, MIT): denim_indigo_twill and jersey_heather_grey; the jeans' felled seams topstitched in gold on one side, a hem chain stitch, back patch pockets, front scoops with a coin pocket, the fly's J-stitch, copper rivets and belt loops; the tee's seams, coverstitch hems and an 18 mm rib crew neck (tools/characters/garments/details.py). GarmentCode halves the tee's torso and sleeves; those centre seams are left bare (`plain seams`), as a real tee has none.
